test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T and U are six friends sitting at equal distances from each other around a circular table facing the centre of the table. U is sitting at the 4th position to the left of T. Someone is sitting between S and T but it’s not P. R is sitting to the immediate left of U. Who is sitting opposite T?
solution:
P, Q, R, S, T and U are six friends sitting at equal distances from each other around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) U is sitting at the 4th position to the left of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a29d8808c4af5215986faa903e384987a309def98be1880539d7301f689b3d8c.png] 

2) R is sitting to the immediate left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e7e355475910cf3a38e76b8c2241953003ad4adce0147c9dd2bbf9c43852dc0.png] 

3) Someone is sitting between S and T but it’s not P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d8058d92c5d0e955875022eaf6142f8c7905f15bf27445a425cf24082b9cbe4.png] 

∴ Here, 'P' is sitting opposite of 'T'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"P".**
